criteria.name: prompt_completeness
criteria.description: Every image description is self-contained — style, palette, and lighting from art_direction are embedded inline in each background and CG description. A description that just says 'foggy dock at night' without style/palette/lighting is not usable. Test: if descriptions require cross-referencing art_direction to be actionable for an image gen model, score 0–40. If each description could be copy-pasted directly to Stable Diffusion and produce a consistent result, score 70+.

criteria.name: visual_specificity
criteria.description: Descriptions are specific compositions, not mood summaries. They name objects, spatial relationships, and at least one concrete detail a generic image of the same location wouldn't have. Test: if a background description is 'a dark hallway, mysterious atmosphere, dramatic lighting,' score 0–35. If it is 'a narrow maintenance corridor, exposed pipes overhead, one flickering fluorescent tube, green emergency exit light casting long shadows on the floor,' score 70+.

criteria.name: coverage
criteria.description: All unique location_ids from the story have a corresponding background entry (prefixed with bg_). All endings have a CG entry. No location or ending is skipped. Test: count location_ids from beat_map against backgrounds, and endings against CGs. Any missing entry brings score below 50.

criteria.name: tonal_consistency
criteria.description: art_direction style, palette, and lighting choices are coherent — they could all be screenshots of the same game. Character appearance descriptions in backgrounds and CGs match the premise's appearance_tags. Test: if backgrounds mix anime flat color with realistic photography styles, score 0–35. If all assets read as the same visual world, score 70+.
